description: List a form's published revision summaries in the project `cwd` resolves to, newest first, one page at a time. Read one with form_revision_get, or restore one with form_revert, passing its `_vid`.

cwd.description: Optional. Directory whose project to use; defaults to the client's workspace root.

sort.description: Form.io sort, e.g. "-modified" for newest first (default: -_vid)

name: form_revision_list

hasMore.description: True when items remain; fetch them with a larger `skip`

total.description: Items Form.io holds for this query, across all pages; absent when Form.io does not report one
